correctness.rationale: The three literal inverse branches give transfer identities L(1)= (1+I_c+I_p)/2, L(I_c)=I_r/2 and L(I_p+I_r)=1+I_c. These prove the two-function subspace and exact eigenmode. Both generating functions have integral 2 alpha. The nine two-letter probabilities follow from integrating the piecewise invariant density and using stationary symmetry. A prohibited triple positive word and positive double positive word disprove first-order Markovity below alpha=3/2; at alpha=3/2 all allowed branches map onto entire destination digit cells and cellwise uniform densities prove the one-step Markov property. Differentiated conditional Shannon entropy is log(ac/b^2)/(2 alpha^2)<0 because 16 alpha^2-12 alpha-9>0. Literal exact rational verification 1343 checks over 32 parameters; finite tests are not a general proof.

originality.rationale: The explicit map, ACIM, invariant-density formula, and constant zero frequency are established in the 2017 paper, and the 2006 paper proves the classical endpoint Markov chain. They are not claimed as new. The exact two-function transient mode, full interval adjacent digit law, conditional entropy strict variation, and sharp interior non-Markov/endpoint Markov distinction are additional parameter-wide claims not stated in the inspected relevant primary work. No matching claim was identified by the actual mathematical-record searches; equivalent unindexed work remains possible.
residual_risks: The 2017 paper gives the invariant density, and some pair entries are computable as corollaries by extra integration; the full composite theorem adds new dynamic and symbolic structure. A specialist may judge its novelty increment smaller than the new formulas suggest.
Not all historical signed-digit literature is freely indexed or available in full; the entire 2006 article was not systematically read.
No independent researcher priority review has been performed.

value.rationale: The 2/3 zero-frequency plateau masks a sharply changing observable process: a full nine-entry stationary two-symbol law, monotone conditional entropy, and a qualitative non-Markov to Markov boundary. An exactly invariant two-function transfer subspace and the endpoint disappearance of its signed relaxation eigenfunction give a distinct dynamical mechanism, uniformly across a canonical matching interval. No claim is made about the entire transfer spectrum, full entropy rate, or outside the interval.
